title: Why Zion's floods are so deadly #Shorts
description:
The Virgin River drops about 71 feet per mile through Zion, and the bare sandstone can't soak up a storm. Every side canyon becomes a funnel. The floods are how the canyon was made.

▶ Full documentary (Zion, Part 1: Zion's Deadliest Day): https://youtu.be/Hlr80lyDlwA

#Shorts #Zion #Geology #NationalParks
